examples.title: Simple Web App
examples.requirements:
I need a basic web application infrastructure with:
- Application Load Balancer
- 3 EC2 instances (t3.medium)
- Auto-scaling group
- Security groups configured properly
- Tags for production environment

examples.title: Database Setup
examples.requirements:
I need:
- RDS PostgreSQL database (Multi-AZ)
- Private subnet
- Security group allowing app tier access
- Automated backups enabled
- Encryption at rest

examples.title: Microservice Deployment
examples.requirements:
Deploy a Flask microservice with:
- 3 replicas
- Rolling update strategy
- Resource limits (500m CPU, 512Mi memory)
- Health checks
- LoadBalancer service
